nodes.label: Concept: Multi-tenant Row Level Security (RLS)
nodes.rationale: Every tenant-scoped table has tenant_id, RLS is mandatory, and tenant context must be set via SET LOCAL app.current_tenant_id within a transaction to defend against cross-tenant data leakage, especially safe with PgBouncer transaction pooling.

nodes.label: Concept: ABAC Default Deny / Deny Overrides Allow
nodes.rationale: Access control defaults to deny; any matching deny policy overrides allow, ensuring safety-first evaluation and reducing privilege escalation risk.

nodes.label: Concept: Idempotency-Key Mutation Safety
nodes.rationale: High-risk mutations require an Idempotency-Key header; same key+hash returns stored response, same key+different hash returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, preventing duplicate side effects from retries/double-submits.

nodes.label: Concept: Soft Delete / Restore / Purge Policy
nodes.rationale: Deletable master/config/draft resources use soft delete (deleted_at/deleted_by/delete_reason) instead of physical DELETE; posted/append-only entities (sales documents, stock movements, audit logs) remain immutable and are corrected via reversal/cancel/adjustment instead.
